job.job_description:
,what_we_do:

FlytBase is an AI-native company building the physical AI layer for the sky. Its platform powers fully autonomous drone-in-a-box operations across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure sites worldwide integrating drones, docks, edge AI, and enterprise workflows into one intelligent system. Headquartered in California with a fast-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is redefining how the physical world is monitored and managed. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. At FlytBase, teams work in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI isn t a side project it s the operating system for how they think, build, and grow.

With 300+ global deployments and 50+ partners in our ecosystem, FlytBase is powering the shift from human-operated to self-driven skies. Our platform transforms off-the-shelf drones into intelligent systems that sync effortlessly with enterprise infrastructure.

,the_role:

As an Agentic AI Engineer, you ll design multi-agent AI frameworks where AI doesn t just make suggestions it takes action. You ll integrate reasoning, perception, and execution into autonomous workflows that directly control drone fleets in the real world. This role blends deep AI/ML engineering with practical deployment skills to build scalable, safe, and high-performance systems.

,what_you_will_own:

Architecting multi-agent frameworks for autonomous decision-making and agent-to-agent communication.

Implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and persistent memory to ground agents in domain-specific knowledge.

Developing Vision-Language Model (VLM) solutions for aerial and sensor imagery analysis.

Enabling agents to autonomously execute Python functions, API calls, and data analysis.

Deploying AI workflows on AWS/GCP with optimizations for GPU efficiency and latency.

Implementing observability and debugging tools (e.g., LangSmith) to monitor and refine agent behavior.

Designing human-in-the-loop safety mechanisms, including fallback protocols and bias checks.

,best_suited_for:

Engineers with a proven track record of AI projects especially multi-agent systems, RAG implementations, or decision automation.

Proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, and cloud environments (AWS/GCP).

Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen).

Builders who thrive in ambiguity, learn fast, and value speed without compromising safety.

,what_makes_you_a_flyter:

Engineers with a proven track record of AI projects especially multi-agent systems, RAG implementations, or decision automation.

Proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, and cloud environments (AWS/GCP).

Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen).

Builders who thrive in ambiguity, learn fast, and value speed without compromising safety.

,what_we_dont_want:

Engineers who only build demos but can t ship production code.

Specialists who refuse to work outside their comfort zone.

People who follow AI hype without grounding solutions in practical use cases.

Anyone who needs constant direction instead of driving their own roadmap.

,why_flytbase:

Here, your AI won t just run in benchmarks it will control fleets of autonomous drones in real missions worldwide. You ll join a high-velocity, high-trust team building a first-of-its-kind technology category with real impact.

,the_perks:

Competitive pay and performance bonuses.

AI-first development environment with cutting-edge tools.

Flexible work hours with core collaboration at Pune HQ.

Unlimited paid time offs.

Direct influence on a product deployed in high-stakes, global environments.
